player_0.content: New plan: I failed to recognize that I had already visited the Bedroom, causing me to enter a loop and miss the remaining unvisited rooms (Workshop and Pantry) before declaring completion. Next time, I will maintain a mental list of visited rooms. When entering a room, I will immediately check if it is already on my list; if so, I will not take any action in that room but instead immediately choose an untried direction from the current room to move to a new, unvisited location. I will only say "DONE" when I have visited every unique room and there are no new directions available to explore.
